label: Google Business Profile (+ Local Services Ads)
terms_note: Business Profile API: request access via the Google Cloud project (API access form), OAuth2 scope business.manage; LSA API: for aggregators / multi-account managers (application). Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Google Cloud project; Business Profile API access request; Local Services Ads API for aggregators)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Business Profile APIs for listings; Local Services Ads API for aggregators' account + lead management) Confidence: **high**.
auth: 1. Google Cloud project → request Business Profile API access (form) → enable APIs; OAuth scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage`.
2. LSA API: available to aggregators managing multiple accounts (application).
reference.limits: - Access form; free; quotas per project.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the Business Profile APIs home (https://developers.google.com/my-business) describes creating and verifying locations, managing listings at scale, Reviews and Posts and engagement metrics ('From calls to bookings'), i.e. listing management, not ad campaigns, budgets or ad reports; access needs an approved Business Profile API request, and Local Services Ads are managed through the Google Ads API (served by the `google` entry). No ads verb maps to a documented call.
